title: Garry Nolan's childhood bedside visitors
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Garry Nolan's childhood bedside visitors, about childhood (age 6-7) at Windsor, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: The podcast host Jesse Michels says that Garry Nolan, a professor at Stanford University, has claimed that as a child of about six or seven, in Windsor, he saw aliens standing at the foot of his bed. Michels is careful to say Nolan does not describe it as an abduction. If true, a respected scientist would have his own early encounter story.
